The Tiki Totem was introduced in **Desktop 1.2**, according to the History section of the Terraria Wiki's Tiki Totem page ("Desktop 1.2: Introduced."). My earlier answer missed this because I checked the general Tiki page and the Desktop version history, not the item's own page. The source is a single wiki page, and it gives no release date, so I can't add more than the patch number.
CONFIDENCE: 85
